headline: Strategy and Strive Finance 136,000 Bitcoin via Preferred Stock
summary: Issuance of preferred stock has financed the purchase of nearly 136,000 bitcoin by Strategy and Strive, creating a funding vehicle that analysts expect to complement the larger spot ETF market.
why: Corporate balance sheet treasury strategies involving crypto provide an alternative mechanism for institutional exposure to digital assets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Institutional debt and preferred equity issuance creates additional recurring buying pressure for underlying bitcoin reserves.
